question: Among German drivers born between 1980 and 1985, find the one who recorded the fastest single lap time in any race since 2010. Return his full name, the year of that race, and the percentage of races since 2010 in which he did not finish in 1st position.

WITH german_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
        d.XCL_038 AS forename,
        d.XCL_039 AS surname
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(d.XCL_040, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        lt.XCL_043 AS race_id,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms,
        r.XCL_066 AS race_year
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 >= 2010
      AND lt.XCL_044 IN (SELECT driver_id FROM german_drivers)
),
fastest_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        fl.driver_id,
        fl.race_year,
        gd.forename,
        gd.surname
    FROM fastest_laps fl
    JOIN german_drivers gd ON fl.driver_id = gd.driver_id
    ORDER BY fl.lap_time_ms ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
race_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_races,
        SUM(CASE WHEN res.XCL_079 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_place_races
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 >= 2010
      AND res.XCL_075 IN (SELECT driver_id FROM german_drivers)
    GROUP BY res.XCL_075
)
SELECT 
    fd.forename,
    fd.surname,
    fd.race_year,
    ROUND((1.0 - (rs.first_place_races * 1.0 / rs.total_races)) * 100, 2) AS percentage_not_first
FROM fastest_driver fd
JOIN race_stats rs ON fd.driver_id = rs.driver_id

    LIMIT 1

    GROUP BY res.XCL_075
)
SELECT 
    fd.full_name,
    fd.race_year,
    ROUND((1.0 - (rs.first_place_races * 1.0 / rs.total_races)) * 100, 2) AS percentage_not_first
FROM fastest_driver fd
JOIN race_stats rs ON fd.driver_id = rs.driver_id
